steps.tx: Non-metastatic systemic, endocrine, neurological, or dermatological manifestations triggered by an underlying occult or overt malignancy are classified as a **paraneoplastic syndrome**. Arising in up to ten percent of all cancer patients, these disorders result from ectopic tumour hormone secretion or cross-reactive autoantibodies elicited against onconeural neoantigens shared between tumour cells and normal host tissues.
steps.say: Non-metastatic systemic, endocrine, or neurological manifestations triggered by an underlying malignancy are classified as a paraneoplastic syndrome. Occurring in ten percent of cancer patients, they result from ectopic hormone secretion or cross-reactive autoantibodies directed against shared onconeural antigens.

vis.caption: Cutaneous and systemic physical stigmata of occult internal malignancy. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: The most frequent paraneoplastic endocrine disorder in clinical oncology is the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (**SIADH**), driven by ectopic production of arginine vasopressin by small cell lung carcinoma. Patients present with euvolemic hyponatraemia, inappropriately high urine osmolality, and natriuresis, managed with fluid restriction, hypertonic saline for seizures, and oral vasopressin V2 receptor antagonists (tolvaptan).
steps.say: The most frequent paraneoplastic endocrine disorder is SIADH, driven by ectopic vasopressin secretion by small cell lung cancer. Patients present with euvolemic hyponatraemia and concentrated urine, managed with fluid restriction and vasopressin receptor antagonists.

rows: Small cell lung cancer, bronchial carcinoid

steps.tx: Ectopic secretion of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) or corticotropin-releasing hormone by small cell lung carcinoma or bronchial neuroendocrine tumours causes **ectopic ACTH** syndrome. In sharp contrast to pituitary Cushing disease, ectopic ACTH features rapid onset of severe hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, hyperpigmentation from pro-opiomelanocortin cleavage, and profound proximal muscle weakness, completely failing high-dose dexamethasone suppression.
steps.say: Ectopic secretion of adrenocorticotropic hormone by small cell lung cancer or carcinoids causes ectopic ACTH syndrome. Unlike pituitary Cushing disease, ectopic ACTH features rapid severe hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, skin hyperpigmentation, and muscle weakness failing high-dose dexamethasone suppression.

left.title: Pituitary Cushing Disease
points: Gradual onset centripetal obesity and striae

right.title: Ectopic ACTH Syndrome
points: Small cell lung cancer or bronchial carcinoid
Severe hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and myopathy
Thoracic CT confirms pulmonary or mediastinal mass

steps.tx: Onconeural autoantibodies targeting intracellular neuronal antigens generate debilitating neurological paraneoplastic syndromes. Circulating **anti-Hu** antibodies (antineuronal nuclear antibody type 1, ANNA-1) are strongly associated with small cell lung carcinoma, causing subacute sensory neuronopathy with painful sensory ataxia, paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis, and severe gastrointestinal autonomic pseudo-obstruction.
steps.say: Onconeural autoantibodies targeting intracellular antigens cause debilitating neurological syndromes. Circulating anti-Hu antibodies are strongly associated with small cell lung carcinoma, causing painful subacute sensory neuronopathy, paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis, and gastrointestinal dysmotility.

vis.alt: Pathophysiology and targeted dorsal root ganglion degeneration in anti-Hu syndrome.
vis.caption: Dorsal root ganglionitis and sensory axonal loss in anti-Hu paraneoplastic syndrome. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: A severe subacute pan-cerebellar syndrome characterised by rapid onset of bilateral limb and truncal ataxia, dysarthria, and downbeat nystagmus is paraneoplastic **cerebellar degeneration**, driven by circulating anti-Yo antibodies (Purkinje cell cytoplasmic antibody type 1, PCA-1). Pathologically caused by cytotoxic T-cell destruction of cerebellar Purkinje cells, it is strongly linked to underlying ovarian and breast carcinomas.
steps.say: A severe subacute cerebellar syndrome characterized by rapid onset of ataxia, dysarthria, and nystagmus is paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration, driven by anti-Yo antibodies. Caused by T-cell destruction of cerebellar Purkinje cells, it is strongly linked to ovarian and breast cancers.

steps.tx: An idiopathic inflammatory myopathy strongly linked to underlying occult adenocarcinomas of the lung, ovary, breast, and gastrointestinal tract is **dermatomyositis**. Clinically characterised by symmetrical proximal muscle weakness, patients display pathognomonic cutaneous signs including heliotrope violaceous periorbital rash and Gottron papules overlying the dorsal metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints.
steps.say: An inflammatory myopathy strongly linked to underlying adenocarcinomas of the ovary, lung, and breast is dermatomyositis. Characterized by symmetrical proximal weakness, patients display pathognomonic signs including a violaceous heliotrope rash and Gottron papules over knuckle joints.

nodes.label: Heliotrope Rash + Gottron Papules + Proximal Weakness

steps.tx: A paraneoplastic dermatosis characterised by symmetrical, velvety, hyperpigmented, papillomatous plaques in flexural intertriginous folds (axillae, neck, groin) is **acanthosis nigricans**. While benign acanthosis nigricans is common in obesity and insulin resistance, malignant acanthosis nigricans presents with rapid, extensive onset involving mucosal membranes and palms (tripe palms), pointing directly to underlying gastric adenocarcinoma.
steps.say: A paraneoplastic dermatosis characterized by symmetrical velvety hyperpigmented plaques in skin folds is acanthosis nigricans. While benign forms occur in obesity, malignant acanthosis nigricans presents with rapid extensive eruption involving oral mucosa and palms, pointing to gastric adenocarcinoma.

left.title: Benign Acanthosis Nigricans
points: Strongly linked to obesity and hyperinsulinism
Gradual onset, confined to neck and axillae
Spares oral mucous membranes and palms
Improves with weight loss and insulin sensitizers

right.title: Malignant Acanthosis Nigricans
points: Driven by TGF-alpha secreted by adenocarcinoma
Rapid extensive eruption involving lips and palms (tripe palms)
Regresses following successful surgical tumour resection

steps.tx: Identification of a paraneoplastic syndrome carries immense diagnostic value, frequently preceding the radiological detection of the primary tumour by months to years. Management mandates aggressive diagnostic search using contrast-enhanced whole-body computed tomography or fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography, as prompt surgical resection or chemotherapy of the underlying **tumour** offers the only definitive cure.
steps.say: Identification of a paraneoplastic syndrome carries immense diagnostic value, frequently preceding detection of the primary tumour by months. Management mandates aggressive whole-body imaging, as prompt resection or chemotherapy of the underlying tumour offers the only definitive cure.
